summary: Created a 5-phase implementation plan for the deploy-staleness completion round trip. The plan widens run_post_deploy_reconcile_pass() in scripts/lib/redeploy-checkpoint-lib.sh from an invocation-scoped (.task_numbers) candidate set to that set unioned with a system-wide specs/state.json sweep for non-terminal deploy-pending tasks, lock-gated and fail-closed for out-of-batch candidates. No new deploy-trigger call site, no edit to the completion-deploy gate, and no edit to any excluded or sibling-claimed file. A new fixture suite (test-redeploy-checkpoint-promotion.sh) demonstrates fail-before/pass-after plus a stale-tree case proving the gate still refuses with exit 6 and an unchanged state.json.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: reproduction harness, system-wide deploy-pending sweep in redeploy-checkpoint-lib.sh, acceptance fixture cases, sanctioned-site prose correction, final gate set.
